title: Notice Counted Up to Preparation Instructions: In-Person Appointments
content:
**The rule.** For a patient cancellation of an In-Person Appointments visit, the notice days given depend on the days before the visit on which the visit type sends preparation instructions (the visit type's preparation days):

- where the visit type sends preparation instructions **3 or more days** before the visit, the notice days given are counted only to the day those instructions go out, that is, the calendar days are reduced by the visit type's preparation days;
- where the visit type sends them **1 or 2 days** before the visit, the notice days given are counted only to the day before the visit, that is, the calendar days are reduced by 1 day;
- where the visit type sends **none**, the notice days given are the calendar days as counted.

The calendar days are the days from the date of the cancellation to the scheduled date, the cancellation date not counted and the scheduled date counted. The preparation days are the figure published per visit type in the patient communications schedule.

**Q. Which bands do the visit types fall into?**
A. From the published preparation days: the In-Office Procedure Visit (7 days), the Annual Preventive Exam (3) and the Advanced Imaging Appointment (3) are in the 3-or-more band; the New Patient Office Visit (2) and the Specialist Consultation (2) are in the 1-or-2 band; the Nurse Visit and the Established Patient Office Visit send none.

**Q. Where exactly is the line between the first two bands?**
A. At 3. Preparation days of 3 reduce the calendar days by 3; preparation days of 2 reduce them by 1 only.

**Q. What does this look like on a calendar?** (hypothetical inputs)

| Visit type | Scheduled date | Cancelled on | Calendar days | Notice days given |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| In-Office Procedure Visit (7) | 2026-11-16 | 2026-11-02 | 14 | 7 |
| Advanced Imaging Appointment (3) | 2026-11-16 | 2026-11-10 | 6 | 3 |
| Specialist Consultation (2) | 2026-11-16 | 2026-11-12 | 4 | 3 |
| Established Patient Office Visit (none) | 2026-11-16 | 2026-11-12 | 4 | 4 |

**Q. Can the notice days given come out below zero?**
A. The rule states the reduction without a floor; for example, an Advanced Imaging Appointment cancelled 2 calendar days before its date gives 2 less 3 days of notice, a figure below zero.
